purpose: Expert calibration rubric for the 16 GCL pages; do not apply it to AIA pages.

dimensions.criteria: Restrained corporate red, white, charcoal and neutral balance; red is purposeful emphasis.
Clear title/body/annotation hierarchy, consistent font roles and readable sizing.
Stable grid, deliberate alignment, balanced visual mass and coherent margins.
One dominant message; supporting evidence is visibly subordinate.
Charts and diagrams encode relationships accurately and legibly.
Whitespace separates meaning; density remains controlled.
Images support the message and use purposeful crops.
Repeated components, titles, colors and page grammar cohere.

review_policy: Independent expert labels first; validate and version weights before treating this as ground truth.
